brand.purpose: Product name on the frame bar.

title.purpose: Record row labels, alert titles (700), button labels.

body-small.purpose: Row messages, notices, field labels (600), links (500).

label.purpose: Uppercase module tab headers; the frame zone label at 0.08em.

mono-meta.purpose: Indices, times, masked numbers, URLs, footers, step count and session clock; tabular figures.

shadows.name: badge-float
shadows.purpose: Extension listing badge only: separates the badge from a third-party listing page. Phone pages carry no shadow.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: System easing for every transition and entrance.

motion.name: post
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0), opacity 0.35 to 1; 460ms ease-out; stagger 170ms per posted row
motion.purpose: A check result posts into the record like a printed line. Off under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: cell-in
motion.value: clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0) to inset(0); 420ms ease-out; delay 240ms + 110ms per cell
motion.purpose: Code cells reveal bottom-up. Off under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: checking-turn
motion.purpose: Dashed ring on a check that is actually running. Off under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: button-state
motion.purpose: Button hover and press. Transition removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: compact-record
breakpoints.purpose: Below it the compact record hides per-row time so the code plate stays in the first screen at 390x844.

breakpoints.name: column
breakpoints.purpose: Max width of the single page column and the frame content.

narrative.overview:
Every surface is a Romanian bank's 3-D Secure / SMS-code confirmation, not a KYC vendor card. A deep indigo frame bar marks the secure zone; under it, on a lilac-grey ground, white modules ruled in hairlines carry the record of what is being checked. Each network check posts a timestamped, masked line into a running record (`+40 7•• ••• 001`), and the issued code lands as the record's final line in segmented one-time-code cells, large enough to read off a projector.

The system is dense and procedural, the way a bank statement is: small uppercase tab headers name what a module holds and what happens to its data, numbers run in one tabular mono grammar, and colour is quarantined so that green and red always mean a result, never decoration. One column, one job per screen, the action pinned in the thumb zone. Trust is shown by naming the check, who runs it and what is never kept, not by security iconography.

Two surfaces share the system. The phone pages (`apps/web/app/(phone)/`) are the canonical source. The Chrome extension's listing badge (`apps/extension/lib/badge.css`) re-declares the same colour, radius and easing tokens verbatim, bundles the same two faces (loaded from bytes through the FontFace API as "CS Public Sans" and "CS JetBrains Mono" so a listing site's CSP cannot block them), and reads as a code plate at badge scale: indigo frame, status cell, ruled tab-headed modules.
keyCharacteristics: Indigo frame bar over a lilac-grey ground; white ruled modules, no floating cards.
Every module opens with an uppercase tab naming its contents and its data handling.
Every number, code, time, masked identifier and state word in tabular JetBrains Mono.
State colour lives only where a result is stated; indigo marks the secure zone and what can be acted on now.
The confirmation record (idx · label · state) is the signature structure; the code plate is its last line.
Flat: depth is tonal layering and 1px rules, never shadow, on the phone pages.

rules.name: The Colour Quarantine Rule
rules.body: Green, red and amber appear only where a result or condition is stated: state cells and state icons, alerts, field errors and reasons, the connection chip and the session clock. Never on headings, module chrome, buttons, the ground or decoration. If a colour does not answer "did it pass?", it is not a state colour.

rules.name: The Reserved Indigo Rule
rules.body: Indigo is the secure zone and the thing in hand: the frame, the action, the code plate, the active step and the check that is running. Neutral rows, finished rows and idle copy stay in the lilac inks. A second accent hue is not part of this system.

rules.name: The One Mono Grammar Rule
rules.body: Every number, code, time, masked identifier, URL and state word is set in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures; words are never set in mono, numbers are never set in Public Sans. Two-digit indices (01–04) and "n / of" step counts, never progress dots.

rules.name: The Fixed Thumb Zone Rule
rules.body: A screen's primary action is pinned to the bottom with `position: fixed`, over a 16px fade from transparent to the ground, with a 150px spacer at the end of the flow so content clears it. Not `sticky`: the root body's `overflow-x` makes sticky inert. Long forms use the inline action stack instead (12px gap, safe-area padding).

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: One H1, one module story, one primary action per screen; steps are counted in the frame ("1 / 6"), not drawn.

rules.name: The Flat Secure Zone Rule
rules.body: On pages the product owns, no surface casts a shadow; a module is defined by its rule and its tab, not by lift.

rules.name: The Slot Mark Rule
rules.body: A one-time-code cell carries its underline as an inset mark: a 3px indigo bar with 2px radius, 9px in from each side and 7px up from the bottom, drawn by a pseudo-element inside the rounded cell. Never a thick bottom border on a rounded box, which bends around the corners.

dos: **Do** open every module with an uppercase tab naming its contents on the left and its data handling or source on the right.
**Do** set every number, code, time, masked identifier and state word in tabular JetBrains Mono.
**Do** mask personal data in the record (`+40 7•• ••• 001`) and keep the code whole on one line.
**Do** keep state colour inside state cells, alerts, field errors and the connection/session indicators; pair every colour with a word or an icon with a screen-reader word.
**Do** pin the primary action with `position: fixed` and a spacer; the root body's `overflow-x` makes `sticky` inert.
**Do** draw the one-time-code underline as an inset `::after` slot mark inside the rounded cell.
**Do** honour `prefers-reduced-motion` for the post wipe, the cell reveal and the checking ring.

**Do** keep strings pinned by tests verbatim (state words "Passed", "Failed", "Checking"; "Proprietar verificat · ChirieSigură VC-XXXX"; API messages shown as returned); change the test and the copy together or not at all.
**Do** use the 20px, 2px-stroke, currentColor SVG icon family for every icon.
donts: **Don't** use green, red or amber on headings, buttons, module chrome or decoration.
**Don't** add a second accent hue or use indigo on idle or finished rows.
**Don't** lift phone-page modules with shadows or present them as floating white cards on white.
**Don't** use shield, padlock or check-circle-pop imagery; trust is stated in words in the record.
**Don't** draw progress dots or fake progress; count steps in mono in the frame and show a ring only while a check is actually running.
**Don't** put a thick bottom border on a rounded code cell.
**Don't** use `position: sticky` for the pinned action.
**Don't** reword verbatim strings pinned by tests or returned by the API.
